---
title: "06 · Multiple imputation (analysis plan v2, section 8.7)"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#install.packages("mice")
library(here); library(tidyverse); library(mice)
source(here("notebooks", "build_vars.R"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Variables for imputation
```{r select}
g9 <- read_rds(here("data", "processed", "isrd3_g9_analysis.rds"))

outcomes  <- c("off_vers", "serious_any", "prop_any", "viol_any", "download_any")
predictors<- c("LEG", "LEG_nolaw", "PJ", "PJ_EQUAL", "EFF",
               "NTS_prof_inst", "NTS_prof", "NTS_shop_inst", "SN_prof_cm", "SN_prof_pe",
               "MOR", "SHAME_shop", "SHAME_hurt", "SHAME_arrest", "SC", "SC_imp", "SC_risk", "SC_self",
               "male", "deprfam", "SCHB", "PEERD", "FAMB")
binary    <- c("serious_any", "prop_any", "viol_any", "download_any", "PJ_EQUAL", "male")

dat <- g9 |>
  group_by(classid) |>                                   # observed class means as auxiliaries
  mutate(aux_cls_nts = mean(NTS_prof_inst, na.rm = TRUE),
         aux_cls_off = mean(off_vers, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(caseid, classid, region, schtype, nondiscloser = num(nondiscloser),
            aux_cls_nts, aux_cls_off,
            across(all_of(c(outcomes, predictors)), num)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(binary), \(x) factor(x, levels = c(0, 1))))

# flags for multiple imputation then deletion (outcomes)
miss_flags <- dat |> transmute(caseid, across(all_of(outcomes), is.na, .names = "miss_{.col}"))
colSums(is.na(dat))
```

## Imputation model
```{r setup-mice}
ini  <- mice(dat, maxit = 0, printFlag = FALSE)
meth <- ini$method
meth[binary] <- ifelse(colSums(is.na(dat[binary])) > 0, "logreg", "")
pred <- ini$predictorMatrix
pred[, c("caseid", "classid")] <- 0           # identifiers are not predictors
meth[c("caseid", "classid")] <- ""
meth; rowSums(pred)[meth != ""]
```

## Run (20 imputations; takes a few minutes)
```{r run}
imp <- mice(dat, m = 50, maxit = 20, method = meth, predictorMatrix = pred,
            seed = 123, printFlag = FALSE)
imp$loggedEvents                              # should be NULL or minor
plot(imp, c("NTS_prof_inst", "LEG", "FAMB", "off_vers"))   # chains should mix, no trend
```

## Save
```{r save}
write_rds(list(imp = imp, miss_flags = miss_flags), here("data", "processed", "isrd3_g9_mice.rds"))

imp_summary <- tibble(variable = names(dat), n_missing = colSums(is.na(dat)),
                      method = unname(meth[names(dat)])) |> filter(n_missing > 0)
write_csv(imp_summary, here("output", "tables", "imputation_summary_v2.csv"))
imp_summary
```
